subtasks: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
Pick up one more upright bread slice from the rack and insert it upright into the empty right toaster slot.
Withdraw the right gripper upward, then press the toaster lever fully down. Release the lever and return both arms to their initial poses with both grippers fully open.
Keep both grippers fully open at their initial poses and let the two seated slices and depressed lever settle.
Press the projecting front edge of the partially lowered toaster lever to the bottom of its guide. Release it and return both open hands to their start poses.
Return both arms to their initial poses with both grippers fully open while the lever stays down.
With both bread slices seated, push the front lever the rest of the way to the bottom of its guide, then release and return both open hands home.
Leave the depressed lever and bread in place. Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their starting poses.
